svg.text: Online Exam & Assignment Platform — A3 revised, cost-optimised architecture
Singapore (ap-southeast-1) · 8,000 students · ~$306/month average (normal $294 · exam $365) vs $1,000 budget · RPO ≤ 5 min · RTO ≤ 1 h · ✓ = SPOF removed · ! = SPOF accepted
AWS Cloud — Region ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) ! single region accepted (restore from backups)
Auto Scaling group · min 2 / max 6 · target CPU 50 % · scheduled scale-out to 4 for exams
Alarms: ALB 5xx · unhealthy targets · DLQ not empty · RDS CPU/connections · Lambda errors
RPO ≤ 5 min: 30-s autosave, synchronous standby, RDS + DynamoDB point-in-time restore
RTO ≤ 1 h: automatic AZ failover in minutes; worst case rebuild the stack from code + restore
New commit → new API package → CloudFormation rolling update of the Auto
Scaling group (one instance at a time, ≥1 always serving) → frontend synced
to S3 + CloudFront invalidation → smoke test.
presigned POST — 40 MB file goes straight to S3 (S3 enforces ≤ 50 MB)
Request path shared by both walkthroughs
Cache-aside reads (non-critical, falls back to RDS)
Security groups: ALB ← internet :443 · API ← ALB only · RDS ← API only.
No NAT: instances reach AWS APIs only via VPC endpoints.
